description: Daily records or week/month aggregates. aggregation identifies sum or unweighted average of stored daily values; daily_min/max are extrema of daily values, not raw samples. days_present counts stored dates; days_expected counts calendar dates in period_start/end clipped to the request, not expected sensor wear. Units and aggregation methods are kept separate. Entirely missing buckets/metrics have no row: missing is not zero. Weekly labels use SQLite %Y-W%W (Monday weeks split at New Year), not ISO weeks; use period_start/end. Limit 500 rows. If truncated, discard the partial response and re-query smaller non-overlapping ranges aligned to complete buckets, or fewer metrics. Do not combine partial bucket averages without weighting by days_present.
name: query_daily
title: Query daily metrics
